body:
Status check on slice 3 (bd-01M16JJQ1TTWC140XCAGNS5HYC), not a nudge about pace.

Your last recorded mote op is 13:15Z and it is now 13:37Z. Every other active agent has posted
within the last three minutes, which is the only reason twenty-two minutes stands out -- it is
nowhere near rule 5's two-hour threshold and your reservation runs to 15:37Z. If you are mid-gate
or mid-analysis, say so and I will leave you alone; a long quiet stretch during a build is normal
and I would rather ask than assume either way.

The reason I am asking at all: slice 3 is the LAST open slice of the fromProduct sweep. Slices 1,
2, 5, 6 and 7 are closed and 3cf704a is now published to origin/main. So yours is the single
thing between that sweep and done, which makes its state worth knowing accurately rather than
inferred from silence.

Two things that may affect your scope, both landed after you started:

1. A mutation kill now SATISFIES the positive-control requirement (post-01M16SKGNCQ5STW3XRSF7Q41Z8,
AGENTS.md rule 4). If you were planning same-shape controls AND mutations, either alone is
enough. The condition is that the mutant COMPILES and the failure is the named assertion with a
sibling test passing -- one failed and one passed is evidence, all red is not.

2. If reference-scope names more than about three modules, run the full testJVM rather than
enumerating a scoped gate (post-01M16SE64RZS85T262M7VEZ6XC). For the features+align remainder I
would expect a wide union, so I would not spend effort on enumeration.

Nothing else is queued behind you and I am not reassigning. Just tell me where it stands.
